aiConfig.title: Agent setup
aiConfig.description: Bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic key. wacrm calls the provider directly with your key — no per-seat AI fees, and your data stays yours. This powers AI-drafted replies in the inbox, the auto-reply bot, and the Playground.
aiConfig.adminOnlyConfig: Only admins and owners can change the AI configuration.
aiConfig.encryptionNotice: Your key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again after saving.
aiConfig.embeddingsHint: An OpenAI key used only to embed your knowledge base (text-embedding-3-small){sameKeyText}. Leave blank to use keyword search instead. Clear it to turn semantic search off.
aiConfig.sameKeyText: — can be the same key as above
aiConfig.transcriptionHint: Anthropic has no transcription API, so voice notes need a separate key to transcribe automatically. Paste an OpenRouter key (openrouter.ai) used only for this — nothing else about your setup changes. OpenAI accounts don't need this; voice notes transcribe automatically with the API key above.
aiConfig.behaviourDesc: Tell the assistant about your business — products, tone, what it may and may not promise. This context feeds both drafts and auto-replies.
aiConfig.promptPlaceholder: e.g. We are Acme, a coffee-equipment store. Be warm and concise. Never quote prices or delivery dates — hand off to a human for those.
aiConfig.qualificationCriteriaPlaceholder: e.g. Score HOT if the lead mentions an available budget and urgency to buy this week. WARM if they show real interest but no clear urgency. COLD if they only ask about price without committing to anything, or go quiet after the first reply.
aiConfig.qualificationCriteriaHint: Optional, free text — your own rules for what makes a lead HOT / WARM / COLD. When set, every inbound message is scored against these rules and the contact is updated automatically — this runs whether or not auto-reply is on, so it works even if a human is writing the replies. A HOT lead's deal also moves to whichever pipeline stage you've marked as "qualified" in Pipeline settings. Leave blank to turn scoring off.
aiConfig.enableAssistantDesc: Master switch. Turns on the “Draft with AI” button in the inbox.
aiConfig.autoReplyDesc: The bot answers new inbound messages automatically (only when no flow handles them and no agent is assigned). Hands off to a human when it can’t help.
aiConfig.salesModeDesc: The bot actively drives the sale — qualifies, handles objections, and moves the deal through the pipeline stages as the conversation progresses, right up to closing it. Still hands off to a human whenever the customer asks for one.
aiConfig.aiSchedulingDesc: When a reply makes a real commitment — "someone will call you tomorrow at 10", an appointment confirmed for a specific time — the bot puts it on the Calendar itself, so nothing said in the chat gets forgotten. Needs the timezone below to compute the right time.
aiConfig.googleCalendarSyncDesc: The bot reads your upcoming Google Calendar events to avoid double-booking, and pushes any appointment it schedules there too.
aiConfig.googleCalendarSyncNotConnected: Connect Google Calendar from Integrations first to turn this on.
aiConfig.timezoneHint: Used to turn a relative time the bot commits to ("tomorrow at 10") into the correct absolute time. Set this correctly before turning automatic scheduling on.
aiConfig.maxAutoRepliesDesc: After this many bot replies in one thread, the bot goes quiet. Pick a preset or type your own — or choose “Never stop” for no reply-count limit. This doesn't stop the bot from handing a conversation to a human earlier — it still does that whenever the customer asks for a person, seems upset, or asks something it doesn't have the information to answer.
aiConfig.autoResumeDesc: When the bot hands a conversation to a human and nobody replies within this time, automatically give it back to the bot instead of leaving the customer waiting. Off by default — a handoff stays paused until someone acts on it.
aiConfig.leadAutoAssignDesc: The moment a lead reaches the qualified stage (a Hot score, or a handoff), it's handed to the next rep on the team in turn — the same even rotation new conversations use — any time of day. Doesn't interrupt the bot: if Sales mode is on, it keeps chatting and closing the deal either way.
aiConfig.mediaSendingDesc: When a customer asks for a photo, brochure, or other file, the bot can send one from the media library below if it matches.
aiConfig.handoffToDesc: When the bot can’t help — or hits the reply cap — it pauses and routes the chat here, with a short note on what happened.
aiConfig.handoffQueue: Unassigned queue (any agent can pick it up)
aiConfig.hotLeadAlertsDesc: Get notified when a HOT lead's last message goes unanswered by a human for too long. The assigned agent is alerted; if the conversation is unassigned, every owner/admin is.
aiConfig.hotLeadAlertMinutesHint: Set to 0 to turn this off.
aiConfig.hotLeadAlertsSaveFailed: Failed to save the alert threshold.
